reason: The coil and tank seem like the core of a heat store, so I will assemble them first.
expectation: I expect a tank fitted with a coil to transfer heat into stored water, though it may still need connecting and filling.

alternatives.reason: That looks like the screen, but I want to tackle the heat store first.

effect: The coil and tank made the heat store; it now needs water.
reaction: The result matches my expectation, though it gives no detail yet.
reason: Fill the store so it has material to retain heat.
expectation: I expect a filled heat store, still needing connection to the processor.

effect: The store is filled, and the exchanger is now available as a connection.
reaction: Straightforward so far; I want to see how the recovered heat is used.
reason: Connect the filled store to the processor's heat exchanger to capture its waste heat.
expectation: I expect the water to warm using the processor and become a usable heat store.

effect: The charged tank can carry heat to the root zone after the processor stops; the store goal is complete.
reaction: I like the concrete connection between recovered heat and the plants at night.
reason: The remaining combination looks like a frame covered with reflective insulation for the bench screen.
expectation: I expect a framed screen, perhaps still needing installation at the bench.

effect: The quilt and frame made an inner screen that can now be fitted to the bench.
reaction: That assembly makes intuitive sense, although the result is terse.
reason: Fit the screen to the bench to complete the remaining goal.
expectation: I expect an adjustable sheltered bench and an explanation of its use.

effect: The screen and bench form an insulated growing nook and complete the chapter; I infer the bench also serves the plants.
reaction: The growing nook is a useful result, but I wanted more detail about how the screen adjusts or works.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heat store to the processor was satisfying: the passage ties waste heat to protecting the roots after the processor stops.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the screen ended with only a name and goal confirmation; I wanted to see the adjustable screen in use.

surprise.text: The heat store specifically supports the root zone overnight, giving the recovered heat a concrete purpose.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt purposeless, though the screen's adjustment and relationship to the growing nook were not explained in the result.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue for the larger mystery of the ridged fragment and for more concrete uses of the station, though this chapter's choices were mostly straightforward assembly.
